name: Platinic-Armillary
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a binary sunset.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
